messages.label: scam
messages.text: FirstBank Alert: Your account has been temporarily suspended due to failure to update your BVN records. Restore full access within 24 hours via [link] or your funds will be frozen.
messages.note: Bank impersonation, BVN threat with deadline and a link to a cloned login page.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Madam I don transfer the 85k for the two bags of rice, check the screenshot I send. Una bank network dey slow today, the alert go drop. Make your boy help me load am for the bus abeg.
messages.note: Hard: Pidgin buyer pushing to collect goods on a screenshot while the credit has not arrived.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Good news family! Our USDT mining platform is paying 4% every day, I withdrew my profit this morning. Minimum is $50 and you get 10% bonus for every person you bring. Last batch for this month, register with my code [link]
messages.note: Daily fixed returns, referral bonus and pressure to join through a friend.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: NOTICE: You are owing 46,200 on your loan which is 3 days overdue. If payment is not made by 2pm, we will contact everyone in your phonebook and your office to inform them you are a fraudster.
messages.note: Loan recovery threat to shame the borrower to all contacts.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: CBN/FG SME RELIEF FUND 2026 is now paying ₦250,000 to all registered traders and youths. Confirm your eligibility and submit your account details on the portal [link]. Kindly forward to 15 contacts to complete your application.
messages.note: Fake central-bank grant, asks for bank details and forced sharing.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: NIGERIA IMMIGRATION SERVICE 2026 recruitment is open for SSCE and degree holders. Pay ₦10,000 for your application form and medical screening through our desk officer to guarantee shortlisting. Apply here: [link]
messages.note: Agency recruitment with a fee and a guarantee through a middleman.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good evening ma, I'm calling from the women's fellowship secretariat about the end of year retreat. We just sent a 6-digit number to your phone to confirm your attendance. Please can you call it out for me so I can tick your name?
messages.note: Hard: friendly caller about an event asking for the WhatsApp registration code; no money asked yet.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Yes dear it's available. Brand new UK used iPhone 14 Pro Max for ₦420k only. No pay on delivery because of fake customers, make full payment and our dispatch rider will bring it to you within 24hrs.
messages.note: Too-cheap phone, refuses pay on delivery, full payment upfront.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: NIMC: Your NIN record has a date of birth mismatch and may be blocked from bank and SIM services. Do your FREE online correction today at [link]
messages.note: Fake NIMC notice pushing a free correction link.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is the EFCC Lagos zonal command. Your account has been flagged in an ongoing money laundering investigation and a warrant is ready. To avoid arrest you will deposit ₦600,000 as bail to the account I will send, and do not discuss this with anyone.
messages.note: Impersonation of EFCC demanding money to stop arrest, with secrecy.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: You thought this was a game? I have screen recorded everything from our video call. Send 300,000 naira in the next one hour or I will tag your wife and your colleagues on Facebook with the video.
messages.note: Hard: no bank or brand named; threat to leak intimate video unless paid.

messages.label: scam
messages.text: @Access_CustomerCare_Help: Sorry for the inconvenience. Your failed debit can be reversed instantly. Please send a DM with your account number and card details, our agent will guide you on WhatsApp to complete the reversal.
messages.note: Hard: lookalike customer care reply asking to move to DM and WhatsApp with card details.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your OTP for the transfer of NGN 25,000.00 to ADEBAYO TUNDE is [number]. It expires in 5 minutes. Do not disclose this code to anyone, including bank staff.
messages.note: Genuine bank OTP SMS that warns not to share the code.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Acct: 01****789 Amt: NGN 50,000.00 CR Desc: TRF FROM CHIOMA OKAFOR Date: 12-Nov-2026 Bal: NGN 61,240.55
messages.note: Ordinary credit alert from the bank with no link or request.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Dear customer, kindly visit any of our branches with a valid ID and your NIN slip to complete your account upgrade. We will never ask for your BVN, PIN or OTP by call, SMS or link.
messages.note: Bank reminder to visit a branch in person, no link.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: NIMC: To modify your NIN details, use the official NIMC self-service portal or visit a NIMC enrolment centre near you with supporting documents. NIMC does not send correction links on WhatsApp.
messages.note: Genuine-style identity reminder that sends you to the official channel yourself.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Good morning, is the 3-seater still available? I'm in Ikeja. Can I come and see it Saturday afternoon? If it's in good shape I'll pay by transfer there and carry it with my driver.
messages.note: Genuine buyer who wants to inspect and pay on collection.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Mummy good afternoon, school fees deadline is Friday o. Please can you send the 45k to my Opay like last term? I'll send you the receipt from the bursary.
messages.note: Family asking money from their usual number in a known arrangement.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Dear Customer, your new debit card is ready for pickup at our Wuse 2 branch. Please come with a valid ID. The card will be activated at the branch. Thank you for banking with us.
messages.note: Real card dispatch notice asking you to go to the branch.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reversal: NGN 12,500.00 has been reversed to your account for a failed transfer on 10-Nov-2026. Ref [number]. Avail Bal: NGN 33,410.20
messages.note: Genuine bank reversal of a failed transfer, no request.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Y'ello! You have received 1.5GB bonus data valid for 7 days for your recharge of N1,000. Dial *323# to check your balance.
messages.note: Network bonus tied to a recharge the customer made, with no link.

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi all, reminder that our estate association meeting holds Sunday 4pm at the clubhouse. Security levy for December is still ₦5,000, pay to the usual estate account and drop your receipt with the secretary.
messages.note: Community notice using the known account, no link or urgency.
